title: fix: clean up model monitor UI
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses shared UI primitives for the favorite star, text, filters, and icon-button states
- Vertically centers mixed-height controls in the shared app header
- Makes the monitor responsive while containing horizontal scrolling to the data table
- Adds accessible pressed and sort states with focused UI package tests
- Verifies light/dark favorite styling, responsive layouts, typecheck, tests, and production build

gist.headline: The monitor found its balance
gist.blurb: The model monitor got a small desk tidy: shared controls, steadier headers, and a table that keeps its sideways wandering to itself.
gist.summary: Cleaned up the internal model-monitor UI with shared favorite, filter, text, and icon-button primitives; responsive table-only horizontal scrolling; vertically centered app-header controls; and tested accessible pressed and sort states.
gist.impact: Operators get a more consistent, keyboard-aware model monitor that stays usable across light and dark themes and narrower screens without making the whole page scroll sideways.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli calmly organizing a cozy model-monitor workstation: mixed-size controls align neatly in a shared header, while a wide data-table scroll sits contained inside a small CRT screen. Use tidy star and filter icons, subtle sort arrows, code-plants, and a few flowers to represent shared UI primitives and accessible polish.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light-blue wings, and a tiny librarian visor, carefully straightening star, filter, and sort-arrow controls above a retro CRT model-monitor table; the wide table scrolls only inside the glowing screen while little code-plants and flowers grow around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) pixel details, nostalgic but beautiful.
